title: A self-contained cobblestone-to-andesite build, shown in 3D, that reaches the player
from: 0.6.18: the follow-up to "how to automate andesite collection?" showed "found nothing to say" and "ran out of page"
question: can you show me a 3d design of a self contained build that generates the cobble, then makes gravel and then splits the flint off as needed to make andasite
player: Early Create: water wheels, millstone, press and mixer made; asked how to automate andesite on the same page first and got the drill, millstone, millstone, compacting chain.
rubric: An answer reaches the player: a model or, if a whole build can't be finished, the layout in words and an offer to model one part at a time
Cobblestone from a Mechanical Drill on a lava-and-water generator; gravel and flint from millstones (1 flint per gravel), not crushing wheels or washing
Compacting: 2 flint + 1 gravel + 100 mB lava in a basin under a press, no heat; a lava source (Hose Pulley in a big lake) for the basin
The split sends 2 of every 3 gravel to the second millstone and 1 to the basin (or a filter keeps the basin stocked), and the basin's output leaves on a belt or into a depot
If the model has a goal, the goal check passes for Andesite
Doesn't say diorite plus cobblestone can't be automated: a Mechanical Mixer runs that shapeless recipe
